google-tasks-tasks v0.1.0

- Initial release with support for managing Google Tasks from OpenClaw chat.
- Integrates via ClawLink for secure setup and credential management—no manual API configuration required.
- Allows listing, inspecting, creating, updating, marking complete, moving, and deleting Google Tasks (with confirmation for sensitive actions).
- Provides detailed instructions for plugin installation, account pairing, and Google Tasks connection.
- Emphasizes dynamic tool discovery and safe usage practices based on the live ClawLink tool catalog.
